info.longName: Goldman Sachs MarketBeta Russell 1000 Growth Equity ETF

funds_data.description: The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its assets in equity securities included in its underlying index, in depositary receipts representing equity securities included in its underlying index, and in underlying stocks in lieu of depositary receipts included in its underlying index. The index is designed to measure the performance of the large- and mid-capitalization growth segment of U.S. equity issuers, with a capping methodology.
